about_the_game:
Imagine waking up as a toy in a world where chairs tower like skyscrapers, patches of grass are forests, and raindrops are catastrophic storms. In TinyRealm, survival becomes an epic struggle for a tiny hero navigating a colossal world inside and outside a typical house.

Scavenge scraps from everyday household items, craft tools and weapons, and build a base out of found materials. Your enemies? Bugs, plants, wild animals—and other toys with their own agendas.

  • Immersive Toy-Sized Survival
    Experience a gigantic world from a minuscule perspective—every item and environment becomes a strategic challenge.

  • Resource Gathering & Crafting
    Salvage bits like bottle caps, wires, and broken gadgets to build weapons, tools, and armor.

  • Base Building from Junk
    Construct defenses and shelters from household scraps—toys, cardboard, nails, and more.

  • Diverse Hostile Encounters
    Clash with bugs (ants, spiders), aggressive plants, larger animals, and unfriendly toys with unique behaviors and strategies.

  • Exploration Across Scaled Biomes
    Discover different zones: cluttered attics, overgrown backyards, cluttered kitchens—each full of hazards and secrets.

  • Dynamic Weather & Time Systems
    Day/night cycles, storms, and changing temperatures impact your survival and strategy.

  • Solo & Co‑op Multiplayer (optional)
    Survive alone or band together with friends online—work together to build, explore, and fight.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3225 3.3 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7300U 3.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 or AMD Radeon HD 7870 equivalent DX11 GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible

short_description: TinyRealm is a stylized survival game where you play as a toy in a giant world. Scavenge scraps, build your base, craft weapons, and survive against bugs, animals, plants, and hostile toys—alone or with friends in online co-op.
